name: linkapp
description: Private self-hosted multi-page link management app (Linktree/mssg.me-style), single admin, unlimited public pages.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
